verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Adyen Agentic speaks the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP). Nothing in the pack says either protocol is published as an open, versioned specification that a developer can read and implement without an agreement. The public adyen-openapi GitHub repo holds Adyen's own API definitions, not an open protocol spec, and no versioning or licensing terms are shown, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a developer, the commerce protocol this product speaks is published as an open, versioned specification I can read and implement without signing anything
